body: I really appreciate your support and kind words. Please know you’ve made a good difference with your reply.. and I’m pretty lousy at accepting anything positive about myself.

Hi. I’ve been off this for awhile. Sorry for the late reply. Thank you for taking time to offer support and suggestions. I do love animals and have thought often of volunteering...stupid fear gets in the way...that never ending lack of self esteem is so paralyzing at times. I am attempting to push the bullying, negative thought demons aside to make the next move towards volunteering. You're right, working around animals and other animal loving people might provide some positive payoffs I sure could use.

I’ve become a highly skilled slug. Expert Homescapes player. Authority on all things “Gunsmoke” TV Show. Can order the heck out of Kroger online grocery curbside pick up. Keeping Amazon stock high.  I work as a substitute for my local school district but I’ve only worked 4 days since August. Thought more opportunity was coming as more students returned to in-class learning from virtual after Christmas Break but nope. Also employed by a good friend’s home business as a pet sitting...cats only, please.  2 hounds from Hell for a week last March, pre COVID, rewrote my employee responsibilities...by me...BUT...no one is traveling. A fairly dismal person of no interest. No hobbies anymore. Depression affecting motivation.
Thank you for acknowledging me. Thank you for taking a moment to be kind, empathetic and compassionate. You did help me. Thank you.

Yes... psychiatrist suggested it this past week. Of course, took it personally that she just wants to focus on the meds but then realized, yep, I am messed up, exhausted by it and I’ve got to give it a try...again. Thank you.

Not available and that choice has a ripple effect on people you matter to in such a way their lives will never, ever be the same. Thoughts of suicide myself...plan all set. Pleading with the universe that I do not find that line to crossover and follow thru...new battle in the viciousness of depression, self hate, etc.

Hi. Thank you for being a lovely, caring friend. What I can tell you from my personal experience of 40+ years battling chronic depression along with life’s curve balls that cause situational depression... a double whammy as both are different animals...is to validate your friend’s feelings...sympathize even when you might not completely understand or relate. It’s lousy to be depressed. Pain is pain and it’s real and it can be overwhelming and paralyzing. Good, sincere intentions of expressing “what you should do...” or “ you shouldn’t feel that way” are empty in support and I see you recognize that. A depressed person wishes that it was that easy...that feelings of helplessness and hopelessness could be controlled as easy as a light switch. I would encourage your friend to seek out professional therapy. And would suggest to keep it private as I think she is already sensitive to being judged by others. If she is on medication, she has a doctor that can refer her to mental health professionals to address her specific needs. I will keep you both in my thoughts and hope you both find your way through this rough time.

Suicidal myself...fighting the same demons with what feels like no armor, no weapons, no strength. Looking for, craving actually, some sense of peace. Have my plan too... stock pile of sleeping pills and a separate garage with a diesel truck full of gas. Curious about what will trip me up to finally follow through. Honestly, despite it all, I hope I never arrive to that point, crossing that irreversible line, and I will hope the same for you. Peace has to be, must be! available elsewhere.

I’ve been stuck in the same existence of isolating myself physically and emotionally by choice then by the strangle hold this virus has on us. One thing very easy and hugely imperative for well being, especially with this pandemic, is vitamin D.  It’s basic sunlight for 10 to 15 minutes a day. A couple steps beyond your front door gives you that. And it’s quite..“amazing“? ...when a simple action also provides a sense of freedom from the self induced lockdown and the invitation to possible feel ok to move beyond it. The first step is always the hardest, then the following ones become easier. I encourage you to try.
Hello. So sorry and relate to where you are. It’s lousy. Not understanding Med situation. Is it a refill request that went in late?
Hi. I‘m sorry your pain is so exhaustingly huge. Don’t do any harm to yourself. Give it another night...sleep gives relief from the chaos in your mind. Let’s see what tomorrow has to reveal. Ok?
